versions.content: Diagnostic Message Validation Failure Security Event Status: DRAFT If DoIPEnableSecurityEventReporting is enabled and SEV_DOIP_DIAG_- MESSAGE_CHECK_FAILED exists, the DoIP module shall report the security event SEV_DOIP_DIAG_MESSAGE_CHECK_FAILED to IdsM with the context data spec- ified in [SWS_DoIP_00514] when a diagnostic message is rejected due to a failure in "Diagnostic message checks." These checks include: • Invalid Source Address • Unknown Target Address • Payload length exceeds target network maximum allowed size • Current available buffer too small • Target unreachable
